description: This source file defines and implements event handling mechanisms for a custom event loop system, including managing socket closures, I/O events, timers, asynchronous events, child process events, signals, preparation and checking hooks within the event loop.

classes.name: closing_socket
classes.description: Represents a socket that is scheduled to be closed after a timeout, manages cleanup in the event loop.

methods.name: void close_socket_now(closing_socket * cs)
methods.description: Closes the socket immediately and frees associated resources.

methods.name: void closing_socket_cb(int revents,void * arg)
methods.description: Callback invoked to handle socket input and timeout conditions, ultimately closing and freeing the socket.

methods.name: void li_event_add_closing_socket(liEventLoop * loop,int fd)
methods.description: Adds a socket to the closing queue and initiates shutdown procedures, setting a timeout for closure.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_init(liEventLoop * loop,struct ev_loop * evloop)
methods.description: Initializes an event loop structure, setting up internal queues and associating with an underlying libev loop.

methods.name: struct:ev_loop * li_event_loop_clear(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the event loop, detaching watchers and freeing resources, returning the libev loop.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_run(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Starts the event loop and blocks until it is stopped.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_end(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Signals the event loop to end gracefully, unreferencing the underlying libev loop.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_exit(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Immediately ends the event loop and unloops all events.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_force_close_sockets(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Attempts to close all sockets scheduled for closure immediately.

methods.name: const char * li_event_loop_backend_string(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Returns a string describing the underlying event backend.

methods.name: void li_event_io_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventIO * io,liEventCallback callback,int fd,int events)
methods.description: Initializes an I/O watcher with specified callback, file descriptor, and events.

methods.name: void li_event_io_set_fd(liEventIO * io,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the file descriptor for an I/O watcher, updating underlying libev structures.

methods.name: void li_event_io_set_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Sets the I/O events (read/write) for a watcher and updates the libev structure.

methods.name: void li_event_io_add_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Adds specified events to the current set of events for an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_io_rem_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Removes specified events from the current set of events for an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_timer_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventTimer * timer,liEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Initializes a timer watcher with callback.
